title: Pie / donut chart
description: Parts of a whole: pie, donut (with a total in the hole) and Nightingale rose. Use them for a few categories (up to ~8) whose shares matter more than exact comparisons. Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a slice, Esc clears; click a legend item to hide a slice.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Outside labels with leader lines show the name and the share; onClick (or Enter on the highlighted slice) reports the selected source.

examples.title: Donut with a total
examples.description: centerValue and centerLabel write the total in the hole; onHover replaces it with the hovered plan, so the tooltip is turned off. legend.toggle is false so the total always matches the visible slices.

examples.title: Drill-down into a cloud bill
examples.description: Clicking a category (onClick) replaces the data with its services; the breadcrumb goes back to the overview. The tooltip hints at the click, and the line under the chart describes the selected category or service.

examples.title: Labels
examples.description: labels places the labels outside (with leader lines), inside the slices or nowhere; labelContent combines the name, the value and the percent.

examples.title: Live poll
examples.description: New votes arrive every second (setInterval, cleared on unmount or pause) and the slices animate toward the new shares. renderTooltip shows the votes, centerValue the running total, and only a change of leader is announced to screen readers.

examples.title: Market share with “Others”
examples.description: The long tail of small vendors is summed into an “Others” slice in a neutral color, so the donut keeps a handful of readable slices; the hole shows the total.

examples.title: Nested rings
examples.description: Two charts stacked: a PieChart of the categories sits in the hole of a DonutChart of their items (a clip-path circle leaves the ring hoverable), and the items take lighter shades of their category color.

examples.title: Investment portfolio with filter tags
examples.description: The tags above the chart and the legend edit the same controlled hidden list through onToggle, and Show all clears it. centerValue sums the asset classes shown, and renderTooltip gives each slice's share of the whole portfolio, not only of the visible slices.

examples.title: Nightingale rose
examples.description: rose makes the radius (not the angle) show the value: good for cyclic data such as months. padAngle, cornerRadius and a small innerRadius soften the shape; each datum's color marks its season.

examples.title: Small multiples
examples.description: One small donut per region with the same colors and order, so a single legend serves them all and the regions compare at a glance.

examples.title: Satisfaction survey by quarter
examples.description: A diverging red-to-green scale set through each datum's color, with startAngle={-90} so the happy answers come first. Picking another quarter animates the slices; the center shows the CSAT and the line below its change from the previous quarter.

ShapeChartCommonProps.palette: Colors of the marks without a color (defaults to the --chart-series-1..8 CSS variables, then the theme colors)

ShapeChartCommonProps.animation: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)
ShapeChartCommonProps.padding: Space around the drawing, in pixels
ShapeChartCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-highlighted) mark changes; null when nothing is highlighted

ShapeChartCommonProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
ShapeChartCommonProps.ref: Imperative handle: getInstance() returns the engine instance (toggle, resize...)
ShapeChartCommonProps.percentFormat: Formats the shares (labels, tooltip); one decimal by default (`40.0%`)
ShapeChartCommonProps.locale: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French. Defaults to the page language (`<html lang>`), then the browser language
ShapeChartCommonProps.texts: Replaces built-in texts of the locale (tooltip rows such as `value`, `share`, `conversion`, accessible names such as `pieChart`, the `noData` placeholder); `{name}`, `{label}` and `{index}` are replaced
ShapeChartCommonProps.hidden: Indexes of the hidden slices / stages / series (controlled); legend clicks then only call `onToggle`
